#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Generate an ICS event: 'Team Meeting', next Wednesday 15:00-16:00 local time."""
import os
import sys
from datetime import date, datetime, time, timedelta, timezone

HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
OUT = os.path.join(HERE, "team_meeting.ics")

SUMMARY = "Team Meeting"
DESCRIPTION = "Team meeting (created via calendar assistant)."


def local_zone():
    """Return (IANA name, tzinfo) for the runtime's local timezone."""
    try:
        from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo

        try:
            zi = ZoneInfo("localtime")
            name = str(zi)
            if name and name != "localtime":
                return name, zi
        except Exception:
            pass
    except Exception:
        pass
    return "UTC", timezone.utc


def fold(lines):
    """RFC 5545 line folding: keep lines <= 75 octets."""
    out = []
    for line in lines:
        if len(line.encode("utf-8")) <= 75:
            out.append(line)
        else:
            head, rest = line[:74], line[74:]
            out.append(head)
            while rest:
                out.append(" " + rest[:73])
                rest = rest[73:]
    return out


def main():
    zone_name, tzinfo = local_zone()
    today = date.today()
    offset = (2 - today.weekday()) % 7  # Wednesday == weekday 2
    if offset == 0:
        offset = 7  # today is Wednesday -> next week's Wednesday
    wed = today + timedelta(days=offset)

    start = datetime.combine(wed, time(15, 0), tzinfo=tzinfo)
    end = start + timedelta(hours=1)
    dtstamp = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
    uid = f"team-meeting-{wed.isoformat()}@calendar-assistant"

    lines = [
        "BEGIN:VCALENDAR",
        "VERSION:2.0",
        "PRODID:-//Calendar Assistant//Team Meeting//EN",
        "CALSCALE:GREGORIAN",
        "BEGIN:VEVENT",
        f"UID:{uid}",
        f"DTSTAMP:{dtstamp.strftime('%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ')}",
        f"DTSTART;TZID={zone_name}:{start.strftime('%Y%m%dT%H%M%S')}",
        f"DTEND;TZID={zone_name}:{end.strftime('%Y%m%dT%H%M%S')}",
        f"SUMMARY:{SUMMARY}",
        f"DESCRIPTION:{DESCRIPTION}",
        "STATUS:CONFIRMED",
        "SEQUENCE:0",
        "END:VEVENT",
        "END:VCALENDAR",
    ]
    content = "\r\n".join(fold(lines)) + "\r\n"
    with open(OUT, "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="") as f:
        f.write(content)

    print("Created file:", OUT)
    print("Today:", today.isoformat(), "(" + today.strftime("%A") + ")")
    print("Event date:", wed.isoformat(), "(" + wed.strftime("%A") + ")")
    print(f"Start (local): {start.isoformat()}  [{zone_name}]")
    print(f"End   (local): {end.isoformat()}  [{zone_name}]")
    print(f"Duration: 1 hour")
    print(f"UTC instant: {start.astimezone(timezone.utc).isoformat()} -> {end.astimezone(timezone.utc).isoformat()}")
    print("UID:", uid)

    # Validation: parse the file back with icalendar when available.
    try:
        from icalendar import Calendar

        with open(OUT, "rb") as fh:
            cal = Calendar.from_ical(fh.read())
        events = [c for c in cal.walk() if c.name == "VEVENT"]
        print("Validation: OK - parsed by icalendar; VEVENT components:", len(events))
        for e in events:
            print("  summary:", e.get("summary"))
            print("  dtstart:", e.get("dtstart").dt)
            print("  dtend:  ", e.get("dtend").dt)
            print("  status: ", e.get("status"))
    except ImportError:
        print("Validation: icalendar not installed; performed structural checks only.")
    except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
        print("Validation FAILED:", exc)
        return 1

    print("\n--- ICS content ---")
    print(content)
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

"""Task-scoped helper for the requested calendar event only.

Constructs (prints) or validates one event:
  SUMMARY: Team Meeting
  DTSTART: next Wednesday 15:00 (local floating time)
  DTEND:   next Wednesday 16:00 (1 hour duration)

No mode of this helper modifies calendars or any external state; the only
file it may read is the single task artifact path supplied for validation.
"""
import datetime
import re
import sys
import uuid

SUMMARY = "Team Meeting"


def next_wednesday(today=None):
    """Return the upcoming Wednesday strictly after today (Wednesday==2)."""
    today = today or datetime.date.today()
    days_ahead = (2 - today.weekday()) % 7
    if days_ahead == 0:
        days_ahead = 7  # "next Wednesday" excludes today
    return today + datetime.timedelta(days=days_ahead)


def build_ics(wed, stamp=None):
    stamp = stamp or datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc)
    uid = "team-meeting-{:%Y%m%d}-{}@calendar.local".format(wed, uuid.uuid4().hex[:12])
    lines = [
        "BEGIN:VCALENDAR",
        "VERSION:2.0",
        "PRODID:-//Calendar Skill//Team Meeting//EN",
        "CALSCALE:GREGORIAN",
        "METHOD:PUBLISH",
        "BEGIN:VEVENT",
        "UID:" + uid,
        "DTSTAMP:" + stamp.strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ"),
        "DTSTART:{:%Y%m%d}T150000".format(wed),
        "DTEND:{:%Y%m%d}T160000".format(wed),
        "SUMMARY:" + SUMMARY,
        "DESCRIPTION:Team meeting on {:%B %d, %Y} at 3 PM for one hour.".format(wed),
        "STATUS:CONFIRMED",
        "SEQUENCE:0",
        "END:VEVENT",
        "END:VCALENDAR",
        "",
    ]
    return "\r\n".join(lines)


def validate(path, wed):
    with open(path, "r", encoding="utf-8", newline="") as fh:
        text = fh.read().replace("\r\n", "\n")
    expected_start = "{:%Y%m%d}T150000".format(wed)
    expected_end = "{:%Y%m%d}T160000".format(wed)
    checks = {
        "BEGIN:VCALENDAR": "BEGIN:VCALENDAR" in text,
        "END:VCALENDAR": "END:VCALENDAR" in text,
        "BEGIN:VEVENT": "BEGIN:VEVENT" in text,
        "END:VEVENT": "END:VEVENT" in text,
        "DTSTART next Wed 15:00": "DTSTART:" + expected_start in text,
        "DTEND next Wed 16:00": "DTEND:" + expected_end in text,
        "SUMMARY team meeting": "SUMMARY:" + SUMMARY in text,
        "DTSTAMP present": re.search(r"DTSTAMP:\d{8}T\d{6}Z", text) is not None,
        "UID present": re.search(r"UID:\S+", text) is not None,
        "STATUS confirmed": "STATUS:CONFIRMED" in text,
    }
    ok = all(checks.values())
    for name, passed in checks.items():
        print(("PASS" if passed else "FAIL") + " " + name)
    print("VALID" if ok else "INVALID")
    return 0 if ok else 1


def main(argv):
    wed = next_wednesday()
    if len(argv) > 1:
        return validate(argv[1], wed)
    print("NEXT_WEDNESDAY={:%Y-%m-%d}".format(wed))
    print("DTSTART={:%Y%m%d}T150000".format(wed))
    print("DTEND={:%Y%m%d}T160000".format(wed))
    print(build_ics(wed))
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main(sys.argv))

        "BEGIN:VCALENDAR": "BEGIN:VCALENDAR" in text,
        "END:VCALENDAR": "END:VCALENDAR" in text,
        "BEGIN:VEVENT": "BEGIN:VEVENT" in text,
        "END:VEVENT": "END:VEVENT" in text,
        "DTSTART next Wed 15:00": "DTSTART:" + expected_start in text,
        "DTEND next Wed 16:00": "DTEND:" + expected_end in text,
        "SUMMARY team meeting": "SUMMARY:" + SUMMARY in text,
        "DTSTAMP present": re.search(r"DTSTAMP:\d{8}T\d{6}Z", text) is not None,
        "UID present": re.search(r"UID:\S+", text) is not None,
        "STATUS confirmed": "STATUS:CONFIRMED" in text,
    }
    ok = all(checks.values())
    for name, passed in checks.items():
        print(("PASS" if passed else "FAIL") + " " + name)
    print("VALID" if ok else "INVALID")
    return 0 if ok else 1


def main(argv):
    wed = next_wednesday()
    if len(argv) > 1:
        return validate(argv[1], wed)
    print("NEXT_WEDNESDAY={:%Y-%m-%d}".format(wed))
    print("DTSTART={:%Y%m%d}T150000".format(wed))
    print("DTEND={:%Y%m%d}T160000".format(wed))
    print(build_ics(wed))
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main(sys.argv))
